name: Margaret of Savoy, Duchess of Anjou

contribution: The daughter of Amadeus VIII of Savoy and Mary of Burgundy.

checks.lead: Margaret of Savoy (7 August 1420 – 30 September 1479) was the daughter of Amadeus VIII of Savoy and Mary of Burgundy. By her three illustrious marriages, she held a number of titles, including Duchess of Anjou, Duchess of Calabria, Countess of Maine, Countess of the Palatinate, and Countess of Württemberg.
